unit: 实时黑板的教具：标注、让图动、板顶的话

steps.title: B 的幂
steps.md:
拖滑块，看 1 怎么往右上角退。

```matrix
id: m-pow
title: B 的幂
let B = [[0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1], [0, 0, 0]]
slider k 1 3 = 1 step=1 label="k"
matrix B^k name=P label="B^{\calc{k}} ="
```

steps.title: 分块
steps.md:
把 $A$ 切成四块：

```matrix
id: m-cut
title: 切成四块
matrix [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6], [7, 8, 9]] name=A label="A ="
split rows=1 cols=1
```

$$\hl{key}{A_{12}} = \begin{bmatrix}2 & 3\end{bmatrix}$$

talk.md: 看右上块：它是 $A$ 的哪几行、哪几列？
